headline: Glioblastoma Survivor Says 'I'm Still Here' in Reunion
meta_description: John Bienvenu, diagnosed with glioblastoma in 2023, reconnects with CBS reporter David Begnaud to share his ongoing survival journey.
summary_short: John Bienvenu, who shared his glioblastoma diagnosis with CBS correspondent David Begnaud in 2023, has reconnected with the journalist to report on his continued surviva…
body:
John Bienvenu, a glioblastoma patient first interviewed by CBS correspondent David Begnaud in 2023, has reconnected with the journalist to share an update on his battle with the aggressive brain cancer.

The follow-up interview underscores a powerful moment in Bienvenu's ongoing journey—a chance to affirm his presence and resilience. For patients facing one of the most challenging diagnoses in oncology, such moments of connection and documented survival become touchstones of hope.

Begnaud's decision to check back in with Bienvenu reflects a growing recognition in journalism of the importance of following patients' stories beyond the initial diagnosis, capturing not just the struggle but the endurance that defines life with serious illness.
